items.source: An immutable ordered set of target objects for RowDocument to Object conversions. Object paths can be extended via push(Object, org.springframework.data.relational.core.mapping.RelationalPersistentEntity).
items.translation: RowDocument 用于 RowDocument 到 Object 转换的不可变有序目标对象集合。可以通过 push(Object, org.springframework.data.relational.core.mapping.RelationalPersistentEntity) 扩展对象路径。

items.source:
A path of objects nested into each other. The type allows access to all parent objects currently in creation even
when resolving more nested objects. This allows to avoid re-resolving object instances that are logically equivalent
to already resolved ones.
items.translation: 这是一条将对象相互嵌套的路径。该类型允许在解析更深层的嵌套对象时，访问当前处于创建过程中的所有父级对象。这可以避免重新解析那些逻辑上等同于已解析对象的实例。
